purpose: development-data diagnostic of existing continuous burst flags; nothing fitted or tuned

category_rule.target_window: within 0.5 s of a target onset
category_rule.nontarget_window: within 0.5 s of a non-target onset and not of a target
category_rule.between_stimuli: inside the task but farther than the tolerance from every stimulus

null_definitions.uniform: flags drawn uniformly from the valid scan grid, same budget and 1.5 s separation, one-to-one matching at the same tolerance
null_definitions.stimulus_blind: flags drawn uniformly from the valid grid centres aligned to any stimulus onset (targets and non-targets alike)
